leads.Personalized Subject Line: Yugo's Way and a reader idea
leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi G. T. Pierce,

My name is Roland Jacobs. I'm a designer and book services specialist, helping authors professionally present, publish, and promote their books.

I came across Yugo's Way while researching recent Readers' Favorite reviews. I was particularly interested in its setup ("Looking for a ray of light in these stressed out, confusing times"), and in this line from the description: "Ever look around at what’s going on in the world and wonder, WTF ".

Those details gave me an idea for how email marketing could help present the book to more of the readers who may enjoy it. I did not see a newsletter signup on your site, so a simple reader list with a short welcome sequence could keep new readers close for your next release.

I'd gladly sketch a complimentary concept sample so you can judge the idea for yourself. Would you be open to seeing it?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs
